segments.name: Battery swapping
segments.description: Sells Smartscooter ePTWs and hardware, and runs the battery swapping network that riders pay subscriptions to use.
segments.evidence: Information was reported to the Company's chief operating decision maker for the purposes of resource allocation and assessment of performance as a single operating segment involving sales of hardware and battery swapping service.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for Smartscooters and enabling hardware, and pay recurring Swap & Go subscription fees for battery swapping.
revenueModel.evidence: Battery subscription recurring revenues generated from Swap & Go customer subscriptions to the battery swapping network, including those from PBGN vehicles, further expanding our revenue base.
